title: CLI Reference
introduction: Browse agentbench commands by category. Search by command, argument, or description; select a command to inspect its usage and parameters. JSON API commands are listed in a separate category.
note: Generated from the ABB CLI parser. Options inherited from a parent command must appear before its subcommand. A dash means no default or description is specified by the CLI.

commands.description: Run all enabled Agents whose status is ready.
commands.usage:
agentbench run [-h] [--sdk NAME] [--sdk-options PATH]
                      [--case-retries CASE_RETRIES]
                      [--retry-delay RETRY_DELAY] [--agent ID] [-y]
                      [--env-file PATH] [--results-dir DIR | --output PATH]
                      [--no-view] [--model MODEL]
                      [--llm-trace-max-bytes BYTES]

parameters.name: -h, --help
parameters.description: show this help message and exit

parameters.name: --sdk
parameters.description: Select an adapter directory listed by 'agentbench sdk list'. Omit only when exactly one adapter is available.

parameters.name: --sdk-options
parameters.description: JSON object of options passed to the selected SDK.

parameters.name: --case-retries
parameters.description: Maximum extra attempts for safe transient Case failures; 0 disables them.

parameters.name: --retry-delay
parameters.description: Initial Case retry backoff in seconds.

parameters.name: --agent
parameters.description: Run only this enabled ready Agent; repeat to select several.

parameters.name: -y, --yes
parameters.description: Confirm this execution without prompting.

parameters.name: --env-file
parameters.description: Load host secrets and defaults from PATH instead of .env.

parameters.name: --results-dir
parameters.description: ABB result directory; managed Suites save DIR/suites/<suite-id>/events.json. Created if missing; independent of SDK output.

parameters.name: --output
parameters.description: Deprecated result location. For managed Suites, a file path selects its parent directory; the requested filename is not created. Use --results-dir instead.

parameters.name: --no-view
parameters.description: Save results without starting the local live viewer.

parameters.name: --model
parameters.description: Target model ID; defaults to the selected provider model environment variable.

parameters.name: --llm-trace-max-bytes
parameters.description: Legacy option: streaming memory spool threshold; payloads are never truncated.

commands.description: Import an Agent and list files for onboarding.
commands.usage:
agentbench agent add [-h] [--agents-dir DIRECTORY] [-b] [-c]
                            [--registry REGISTRY]
                            [--build-settings BUILD_SETTINGS]
                            [--build-model BUILD_MODEL] [--answers ANSWERS]
                            [--with-observe] [--agent-timeout AGENT_TIMEOUT]
                            [--adapter-context ADAPTER_CONTEXT]
                            [--env-file ENV_FILE] [--model MODEL]
                            [--output OUTPUT] [--no-view] [-y] [--sdk NAME]
                            [--sdk-options PATH]
                            SOURCE

                           [--llm-trace-max-bytes LLM_TRACE_MAX_BYTES]

                           [--output OUTPUT] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                           [--cases CASES] [--max-steps MAX_STEPS]
                           [--case-file CASE_FILE] [--judge JUDGE]
                           [selection]

commands.description: Rerun a saved Case or Suite with fresh Agent execution and judging.
commands.usage:
agentbench reuse [-h] [--suite-root SUITE_ROOT] [--agent AGENT]
                        [--case CASE_NUMBER] [--output-root OUTPUT_ROOT]
                        [--env-file ENV_FILE] [--model MODEL]
                        [--max-steps MAX_STEPS]
                        suite

parameters.name: -h, --help
parameters.description: show this help message and exit

parameters.name: suite
parameters.description: Suite ID/path (all Cases), or Case ID, artifact run ID, saved Case/attempt path (one Case).

parameters.description: Directory to search for saved Suites; defaults to project results and indexed Suites.

parameters.description: Exact Agent ID; use with --case and a Suite source.

parameters.name: --output-root
parameters.description: Only join/create reuse Suites under this directory; new batches otherwise use the original parent.

parameters.name: --env-file

parameters.name: --model
parameters.description: Agent model for the new Suite; defaults to the saved model.

parameters.name: --max-steps
